name: Xinming Li
biography: I am a PhD student at the College of Design and Engineering, National University of Singapore, advised by Prof. Xiao Gong. My research focuses on high-performance memory devices.
I received my B.Eng. from Shandong University in 2024, where I worked with Prof. Yuan Li on first-principles and quantum-transport simulations of tunnel field-effect transistors.
interests: Ferroelectric memory and BEOL-compatible oxide-semiconductor FeFETs
Dual-gate device structures and three-dimensional memory architectures
Device reliability, first-principles calculations, and quantum transport

education.degree: B.Eng. in Micro-Nano Optoelectronic Science and Technology

news.text: I presented my work on oxide-semiconductor twin-gate FeFETs at the IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits in Hawaii.
